card.name: Field-of-study words after a modifier
card.fires_on: The first word of a subject, discipline or profession name, such as technical, drawing, chem, logic or medical. It follows a modifier or preposition in general web text.

modes.label: Profession or field name
modes.description: A field word that begins a role or discipline, often before a noun like writer or history.
modes.example: Lori Kaufman is a freelance<< technical>> writer who likes to write geeky how

modes.label: Subject after 'in' or 'of'
modes.description: A subject area named as someone's area of study or interest.
modes.example: I recommend the Handbook to researchers and graduate students in<< logic>>, mathematics, computer science, philosophy,

modes.label: Start of a split word
modes.description: The opening piece of a longer word naming a specialist or field.
modes.example: is one of the most inventive<< chem>>ists of all time.

card.writes: It seems to promote word endings and nouns for scholars and fields, such as theorists, logic and leagues.
card.plain: It lights up on the first word of a subject or specialty, like technical, chemistry or logic, in ordinary web prose.
